answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The voyage holds work receipts rather than names, so the tide of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
